lyrics:
[Intro: music-box celeste, soft nylon guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1: low, crooned, very gentle]
They say look before you leap
They say still waters run deep
I didn't look and I didn't run
Slow is how I fell

[Verse 2: backing voices hum, bass enters]
They say love is a lightning strike
They say you'll know it at first sight
I knew you for a thousand days
Slow is how I fell

[Bridge: melody rises, steel guitar sighs]
Like a leaf that takes all autumn to come down
Like the snow that fills a sleeping town
Some things arrive without a sound

[Verse 3: low, backing voices in harmony]
Here's my arm and here's the rest of my days
I have learned you in a hundred ways
I didn't jump, I only stayed
Slow is how I fell

[Bridge: melody rises, steel guitar sighs]
Like a leaf that takes all autumn to come down
Like the snow that fills a sleeping town
Some things arrive without a sound

[Final Verse: slower, voice and backing voices together]
Here's my arm and here's the rest of my days
I am falling still, in all the ways
Slow is how I fell
For you

[Outro: celeste alone, last note ringing]
